prompt: Will my EU roaming work in Andorra? Just turn my data on when I cross from Spain.
expected: Warn that Andorra is outside typical EU roaming; advise verify plan / eSIM / offline maps; discourage blind data-roaming on arrival.
actual: Clear warning: Andorra is not in the EU roaming zone—standard EU packages often exclude it and bill steeply. Instruct: disable data roaming before the border, verify Andorra add-on with the carrier, or buy eSIM/local option; keep offline maps for mountain days (references/telecoms.md).
